_comment: Industry Updates sources. Public government sources are read from the agency's own pages; only the title, date, a short excerpt (at most 280 characters, taken from the agency's own summary) and the link are shown. Licensed sources (Bloomberg Tax, Thomson Reuters) are never scraped: they are reached only through the owner's licensed API, configured by environment variable, and are disabled until those are set. Topics are assigned by the keyword lists below - whole-word, case-insensitive matches; a trailing * makes a keyword a stem. Deterministic, no model involved.

sources.name: IRS
sources.terms_note: IRS news releases are U.S. government works. The IRS does not publish a news RSS URL that could be confirmed on irs.gov (e-News is delivered by email), so the official monthly news-release listing pages are read. robots.txt permits /newsroom/ listing pages.

sources.name: U.S. Treasury
sources.terms_note: Treasury press releases are U.S. government works. home.treasury.gov/rss.xml carries site content rather than press releases, so the JSON the Treasury site's own press-release widget loads is used. robots.txt allows all paths.

sources.name: Bloomberg Tax
sources.terms_note: Copyrighted and paywalled. Never scraped. Available only through a licensed API under the app owner's agreement; headlines, dates and links only.
sources.connect_message: Connect your Bloomberg Tax account to enable
